reasoning_traces.think:
Apperception models the brain as a hierarchical generative process where bottom-up sensory data is fused with top-down prior expectations. Mathematically, this is captured by the Bayesian posterior update: P(H|D) ∝ P(D|H)·P(H), where the hypothesis H represents the cognitive mass and D the data. When P(H) dominates, perception becomes highly subjective; when P(D|H) dominates, it becomes objective. The failure mode occurs at singularities where prior beliefs become infinite or zero, causing the posterior to degenerate. This unifies GSI's probabilistic sportsbook odds calibration and GSE's situational reasoning by treating both as state-estimation problems under uncertainty.
